_meta.description: Broadway weekly running-cost index by contract year (BRO-4989). Backbone: the Actors' Equity Production (Broadway) contract weekly minimum. Used to carry a dated weekly-cost figure to another week (costForWeek). Not ticket prices.
_meta.method: Each point is the Equity weekly minimum in effect from effectiveDate. Values between points are geometric interpolation. basis: 'sourced' = the figure is printed in the cited source; 'derived' = a sourced figure times a sourced contract raise; 'interpolated' = geometric between two sourced figures (no public figure found for those years); 'extrapolated' = before the first sourced figure, at Local 802's sourced 2003-2007 average raise; 'scheduled' = a raise the ratified contract schedules for a future date. Local 802 and Local One raises are recorded under corroboration and are not used in the arithmetic.
_meta.maintenance: Add a point when a new Equity Production contract is ratified (next: Oct 2028). The unit test fails if a point lacks a source or the series falls.
